text_block_list.text:
A fresh start. Agnes Digital swore to keep 
her love for Umamusume strictly as a hobby 
and live solely for racing, but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaah!? Seriously now, you're getting way 
too ahead of yourself, aren't you!?

Once the lingering excitement of the Japan 
Dirt Derby cooled down, things became 
considerably calmer...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Me? Become someone like all the other 
Umamusume-chans? Could I really?"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Dreaming is free, sure! But the midsummer 
heat really cooked my brain into puffed 
rice, huh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, Trainer! The real question 
is whether that's even possible at all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
All those precious Umamusume. To think 
that I, who've always just basked in their 
brilliance, would stand on the very same 
starting line.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Even if I change my attitude now, I wonder 
how much ground I can make up for all the 
time I spent lost in daydreams and idle 
slumber...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Isn't this basically an impossible 
game...? I haven't given up, but still...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I have no choice but to channel this 
helpless anxiety into my manuscript... 
Now, back to my room to continue...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? It's a book manuscript.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: A King doujinshi.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's a book centered on King Halo-san. I'm 
planning a 16-page manga depicting her 
glorious daily life...

A conversation can't even happen without 
asking questions every single time. It 
looks like they're putting together an 
unofficial fanbook.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A King doujinshi, huh. I'd appreciate it 
if they at least asked for the person's 
permission first, though.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, I'm sorry. Letting the person 
themselves know about this kind of thing 
is pretty taboo...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Wait, whaaat, King!?
The protagonist popped out of the book.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
T-That talk about the book just now was a 
joke! A non-existent book, or rather, just 
a silly delusion of mine...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, whatever brought you to 
see a humble person such as myself?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Just dropped by to say hello. Digital-san, 
you're...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I heard you're running in this year's Mile 
Championship?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees! I was so moved by King-san's 
incredible run last year, I wanted to 
share in some of that luck...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thanks. Though if I'm running—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Rivals, huh? I'm entering again this 
year, too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAAAT!? You will be gracing us with 
your presence this year as well!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, though... How far I can actually go 
remains unknown.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ah...

Agnes Digital's expression suddenly clouds 
over. Could there be a reason for it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Um, well... It's just that King isn't in 
as great form as she was last year, so to 
speak...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"A strong 3rd-place run in the Yasuda 
Kinen! However, after falling into a slump 
with an 11th-place finish in the G2 prior, 
she's currently rebuilding her form. This 
summer will be the turning point!"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wait, even the finishing order...? You 
know quite a lot. Almost as much as the 
juniors who always do the King Call for 
me...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course! After all, she's one of 
my absolute favorite Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Um, King-san, it might be presumptuous of 
me to say this, but... I'm really rooting 
for you.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
We might be rivals in races, but... um, my 
feelings of cheering for her won't lose to 
anyone either!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. Well, I'm counting on you. I'll show 
you a race worthy of the King name."

After saying that, King Halo walked off 
with a glum expression. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, if that's how it's gonna be... Change 
of plans!
choice_data_list:
A change of plans... Are we skipping the 
Mile Championship?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it. What we are changing 
is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: The contents of the book, that is!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"The plan was to buy manga. But if it's 
for the sake of supporting King, my own 
tastes come second...!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I want this to be a book that injects King 
with energy. As someone who runs alongside 
her!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The issue is the content, though. What 
kind of book would cheer people up...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have any ideas?

Speaking of books that might bring some 
vitality...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A chant guide! That's it! I'll put 
together a masterpiece chant guide to stir 
King's soul...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Let's spread the word to the fans and make 
it required study! Trainer, please help me 
out.

And so, Agnes Digital finished her book in 
between her summer training sessions, and—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Digital-san, what in the world is about to 
start?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, really. King-san, please just 
stand right here.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all you volunteers. Have you read 
through your chant books? Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: And this person's name is—?!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: King!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Stronger than anyone?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: The winner!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: What does the future hold?

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Brilliant and dazzling! The Umamusume 
everyone looks up to~!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we go—! Everyone, let's keep 
cheering King on together!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Kiiiing, Kiiiing, King King King King!!

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Kiiiing, Kiiiing, King King King King!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, did you go out of your way just to 
show this to me?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's quite an arrangement on the 
usual King Call, isn't it?

King Halo looked delighted. Just hearing 
her cheers was enough to fill me with 
strength.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
A fan art collection! That's it. If it's a 
booklet like that, maybe it's fine to hand 
it to her directly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
In that case, all that's left is to go on 
a pilgrimage to visit the god-tier artists 
at the training camp...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Please! Just one illustration of the 
gallant Miss King, I beg of you!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, if you're okay with something Rice 
made... Is a picture-book style fine...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
W-Why ask me?! It's not like I *can't* 
draw it, but...

And so, Agnes Digital went around asking 
every single person. And then—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A present for me...? Um, Digital-san, what 
kind of book is this...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I hope seeing this cheers you up. Just 
consider it a humble offering from me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what an elaborate summer gift. Thank 
you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh? What is this... insanely detailed 
illustration?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"Th-That's...! Out of pure devotion, I 
ended up pulling three all-nighters to 
draw it...!"

"Her own cheer illustration had the most 
effort put into it. Gathering and drawing 
illustrations seemed to have cultivated a 
great deal of perseverance in her."
